title: maca check --json
description: What `maca check --json` prints: one object, holding every diagnostic for every file it was given. A code names one defect forever and is never reused, so a consumer may branch on it.

format.description: The shape's version. It rises when a field's meaning changes, so a reader can refuse a format it does not know.

position.description: A byte offset and the line and column it falls on. Lines and columns count from one; a column counts characters, so a multi-byte character before it counts once.

suggestion.description: A replacement for one byte range. `maca fix` applies the machine-applicable ones and no others.

replacement.description: The text to put in the span's place. Empty means delete it.

applicability.description: machine-applicable is always correct and is applied without asking. maybe-incorrect is the likely intent and is offered, never applied.

code.description: The stable code. It names one defect forever and is never reused: retiring a kind retires its code with it, and the next kind takes the next number rather than the free one.

message.description: What is wrong with this occurrence.

explain.description: What the code means in general, independent of this occurrence.

note.description: What to do about it, when that is more than the message can carry.
